Fashion Show · IamMoody Event

WinterWearWellness – A Heart for Fashion

Sat, Dec 15, 2018 · 6:30 PM – 10:00 PM · The Kahler Grand Hotel

When
Sat, Dec 15, 2018 · 6:30 PM – 10:00 PM
Where
The Kahler Grand Hotel
20 2nd Ave SW, Rochester, MN

Come dressed to impress and enjoy a night out with us as we showcase local designers exclusive collections to the public. Winter.Wear.Wellness- A Heart for Fashion, is a first year event bringing together the community of Rochester to enjoy an evening of fashion entertainment geared toward a charitable cause. Entertainment will include: a presentation by our non-profit parter, a showcase of the exclusive collections brought to you by local designers produced by IAmMoody, a photo backdrop to catch the moment, live DJ entertainment, and full bar services. V.I.P. lounge admission is availble with online ticket sales, as well as upgrades at the ticket registration.

Ticket details:
-General admission $20
-V.I.P $50

Tickets can be purchased at:
https://winterwearwellness.eventbrite.com

Event Details:
-Doors open at 6:30pm
-Check in/Meet & Greet 6:30pm – 7:30pm
-Fashion Show & Presentation 7:30pm – 8:30pm
-V.I.P After Party 9:00pm – 10:00pm

V.I.P Experience includes:
-Gift bags
-Front row seating reserved
-Hors d’oeuvre served in V.I.P lounge
-After party admission

We look forward to seeing you there!

*Nonprofit Partner: Ronald McDonald House

Tickets can be purchased at:
https://winterwearwellness.eventbrite.com
